Content: avoid answering or seeming to heed by speaking off the topic, or pretend to be doing s.t. else in order to avoid the embarrassment of a confrontation.
Ayaw paalibagbag ug basabása myintras gisultíhan ka nákù,
Don’t sit there reading while I am talking to you.
Gialibagbágan (gipaalibagbágan) ku níyag tubag kay dì man siya muadmitir nákù,
He answered me off the topic to avoid admitting it.
